text:
Ava: FYI preflight: full v2 unified-api rollout tonight at 00:00 UTC. Integration smoke showed request-sign mismatch from some legacy gateways leading to 401s for a handful of tenants (gateway-legacy cluster). Can we carve them out and pin to v1 for the night?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: v2.6.0 -> global in 45m. Plan: staged slices 5% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% over 120m. No pins currently. :robot_face:

Noah: saw 401 spike in the gating tests. Looks like header casing normalization in the new gateway layer. It's a compatibility change, not model. Agree to pin affected tenants.

Sora: how many tenants and how long do we pin? Clients want a stable window overnight until the docs + gateway shim ship.

Ava: affected: tenant-501, tenant-502, tenant-999. Propose pin until 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z so support can notify customers and we push the shim.

Marta: ops ask: rollback criteria if the rollout causes new auth failures elsewhere? I'd rather widen pins than full rollback overnight.

Noah: suggested criteria in patch runbook:
- If global 401/403 >0.8% sustained for 5m and correlates to header-normalization -> pause rollout and pin correlated tenants
- If global 5xx >0.5% for 3m -> immediate rollback to previous routing config
Prefer pause+pin over full rollback for this change.

Ava: okay. I'll run the deploy-bot pin command. Please execute as single confirm message.

Ava: /deploybot pin --tenants tenant-501,tenant-502,tenant-999 --reason "staging auth header-case normalization" --until 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z

deploy-bot: Pin request received for tenant-501, tenant-502, tenant-999. Please confirm in one message listing tenants to execute. :eyes:

Marta: confirm: /deploybot confirm-pin tenant-501,tenant-502,tenant-999 --note "hold for gateway shim + docs"

deploy-bot: Pins applied: tenant-501, tenant-502, tenant-999 -> pinned to v1 until 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z. Action ID: d4f1b2. Proceeding with rollout for non-pinned tenants.

Noah: I'll add a short release-note callout: "v2 introduces header-case normalization in the gateway. If your integration relies on exact header casing, wait for gateway shim or upgrade gateway client."

Ava: can docs team add a blurb and link to the shim PR. Also ping CS so they can email affected customers with the pin action ID.

Sora: adding monitoring: creating a temporary dashboard tile filtered to exclude pinned tenants and a fast alert rule for >0.5% 401s on /v2/* to avoid noise.

Marta: logs from the smoke that tripped this:
``` 
[2026-03-24T23:03:12Z] auth_fail header_mismatch tenant=tenant-501 req=aa11 gateway=legacy-us-east
[2026-03-24T23:03:13Z] http 401 tenant=tenant-501 path=/v2/predict latency=5ms
```

Noah: plan after rollout: ship gateway shim (hotfix slot tomorrow morning), push docs PR, then unpin tenants and do a controlled unpin window: 2h observation at 10% traffic then full unpin. If any pinned tenant shows >1 incident in 2h after unpin, re-pin and open hotfix.

Ava: record for release notes: add an entry under "Known migration caveats" with the action ID d4f1b2 and the temporary pin window.

deploy-bot: Rollout continuing for non-pinned tenants. Current slice advanced to 30% after monitoring window.

Marta: monitoring stable. No uplift in 5xx or 401s for non-pinned set.

Sora: CS notified with action ID and proposed customer email draft.

Ava: closing thread 1: pins applied, rollout proceeded for remainder, ops & CS on watch. Will reopen if rollback criteria hit. :white_check_mark:
